protocol.initialization: single common SFT checkpoint frozen by configs/sft_v1.json; same original NF4 base and rank8 q_proj/v_proj LoRA
protocol.generation_distribution: unwarped categorical policy, so saved token log probabilities match the actual sampling distribution; EOS included
protocol.parents: standard GLS then 11 unique train-corpus targets, round-robin lexical training family and lexical target SHA; fixed before any RL outcomes
protocol.training_prompt: identical terminal-only TASK and real fixed-parent endpoint summary in both reward arms; no heldout or previous RL outcomes
protocol.teacher: previously fixed stage2 three-seed equal Transformer ensemble, no checkpoint or weight selection from R2 holdout

reward.terminal: clip(parent mean gap pp minus child mean gap pp, -1, 1)
reward.state_raw: tanh(mean over bank of qualified child-minus-parent predicted pp / 0.01); unqualified states count zero; qualified iff abs(mean)>max(0.001, across-seed std)
reward.state_scaling: within each group, reduce auxiliary bound to min(0.02, minimum strictly positive distinct valid terminal reward separation / 4). If all valid terminal rewards tie use 0.02. Invalid has zero auxiliary. Thus auxiliary cannot invert any distinct terminal reward ordering; clipping ties disclosed.
reward.duplicates: consume output; no artificial duplicate reward penalty; program and endpoint behavior duplicates recorded
reward.selection: no proxy-based program or checkpoint choice; use last predeclared group adapter, all seeds retained

protocol.objective: GRPO response-token mean clipped surrogate plus k3 KL to fixed common-SFT reference adapter; sequence means averaged across four outputs
protocol.advantage: population std; (reward-mean)/(std+1e-8); skip the whole update when std<=1e-8, record the skip
protocol.resume_verification: first nonzero-variance actual group: populated optimizer and RNG next-update replay, roll back both verification updates; numerical error tolerance 1e-6 params and 1e-5 loss
protocol.teacher_diagnostic: after all four RL adapters frozen, replay at most first 12 distinct changed-action parent-child-state pairs with conventional continuation seed71; no threshold/reward adjustment; separate measured-reference cost
